title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. heteroschistum
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. heteroschistum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin infections. Bioactive constituents of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. heteroschistum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
